hints.title: Alternating Parity Invariant
hints.text: An alternating permutation requires adjacent numbers to have differing parity.

hints.title: Greedy Lexicographical Search
hints.text: Determine available candidate numbers position by position in ascending order to construct the lexicographical kth permutation.

hints.title: Factorial Counting and Clamping
hints.text: For each candidate, compute the number of valid alternating completions using factorials clamped to avoid overflow. Decrement k when skipping candidate blocks.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of elements to permute
complexity.notes: Greedily builds permutation position by position using factorial counting with parity checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all alternating permutations using backtracking times out for n > 12.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Factorial counting avoids visiting branches outside the target index range.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Construct the permutation greedily using the factorial number system with parity balance checks.
